channel.title: Swagger incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Swagger's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: SwaggerHub API Editor — Issue Investigating [resolved]
item.description: Some users may see a blank or unresponsive page when opening the API editor on app.swaggerhub.com. Our team is actively investigating. Issue started ~10:30 UTC following a scheduled release.

item.title: Swagger Studio - Intermittent 502s [resolved]
item.description: We experienced intermittent availability issues affecting our front-end services. Our team identified the issue, took corrective action, and confirmed service stability following the event.

item.title: Investigating — Delayed webhook delivery, and verification results [resolved]
SwaggerHub — Intermittent 502 Errors [resolved]
item.description: Between 06:18–06:35 AM CEST, some users may have experienced intermittent 502 errors on app.swaggerhub.com; the issue was caused by an unexpected traffic spike, resolved automatically, and no data loss occurred.

item.title: Swagger Studio - 502s [resolved]
item.description: We experienced intermittent availability issues affecting our front-end services. Our team identified the issue, took corrective action, and confirmed service stability following the event.

item.title: Partial outage: contract publishing and deployment checks [resolved]
item.description:
We have resolved the issues.
It is our goal to provide the highest level of uptime and reliability so we can consistently serve our customers.
For additional support, please reach out to Customer Care via https://support.smartbear.com/pactflow/.

item.title: Issues in connecting to the Pactflow UI in certain regions [resolved]
